descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-02 step 4 + ER; UAT 3.3 · “the app shows "N patients are already on your list" with an "add only the new ones" option”.

Decision D15 · S1 · Daniela

Overlapping scan: TFA-92580 AC 5 and the UAT ask for one step 'N patients are already on your list, add only the new ones'; the app (like prototype p72) asks about each overlapping patient one by one (Hospital 'Possible duplicates … Same patient / Different') or shows 'N already · N new · N to review' (Nursing Home), with no add-only-new step. Which one? (Q1; AC 1 'match p72' and AC 5 disagree)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-02/S11

Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S12 Nursing Home day-2 overlapping resident list: 'N already', add only the new ones, nothing overwritten, no silent merge or duplicate

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 When a day-2 scan overlaps day 1, the app shows 'N patients are already on your list' with an 'add only the new ones' option. … (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 5; TFA-92580 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U5 An overlapping scan leaves existing patients' data untouched. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U6 New patients get a Follow-up badge: scanned ones (including the new ones from a day-2 scan) and manually added ones. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 4; TFA-92580 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U7 A scan never invents an MRN, room or name. A field the photo did not have is left blank and flagged. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 6; TFA-92580 How it works 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • T2 Silent, backend-only logging: every patient add tagged Scan or Manual, every patient removed or discharged, and every duplicate prompt as shown, accepted or rejected. … (TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Local stack. Seeded through the backend before the agent starts, in All Residents and In Today, the way a day-1 scan of n-day1-clean.png stores them (no MRN): QA Juniper 1938-04-02 Cedar 10, set to New Admission, pre-round text 'QA-PR-JUNIPER seeded pre-round marker', open task 'QA-TASK-JUNIPER check weight' · QA Kale …

When Scan n-day2-overlap.jpg and add only the new residents. If the app shows review rows instead: QA Juniper and QA Larch (no DOB on the photo) are the same resident; the QA Kale born 1952-10-10 is a different resident (add)

Then The app says 2 are already on the list (QA Juniper by name + DOB, QA Larch by name only; Q7) and offers to add only the new ones (TC-09's '2 already known … add the new ones?' is also accepted until Q1 is answered). The QA Kale born 1952-10-10 is never counted as already on the list without asking and is never dropped: it becomes a second QA Kale, or the ap …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on the checkpoints (overlap wording is Q1; either the TC-02 or the TC-09 wording passes, and the wording seen is recorded as evidence). 'SNF-' on a new resident is an invented MRN (U7). The chart checkpoints prove nothing was overwritten (Q7 for the unit). The required backend checks decide 'no silent merge or duplicate' and T2. A Pass needs both. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows; to be decided by Daniela.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (mocked day-2 rows)); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (activity log local); Source: newspec-c.
